Jalen Duren Deadline — 3 Days Left
**Decision:** FOLLOW UP (previous coverage: Sept. 22-27)
**Sources:**
- ESPN: "This is just a staring contest: Where Pistons, Jalen Duren stand in contract stalemate" — https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49777992/nba-free-agency-detroit-pistons-jalen-duren-contract-standoff
- Yahoo Sports: "Pistons' Jalen Duren has little time to make $200M contract decision with looming deadline" — https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/pistons-jalen-duren-little-time-135547852.html
- Yahoo Sports: "Detroit Pistons Can Extend Jalen Duren's Qualifying Offer Deadline" — https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/detroit-pistons-extend-jalen-duren-190034499.html
- Spotrac: "Jalen Duren Contract, Salary & Cap Hit 2026" — https://www.spotrac.com/nba/player/_/id/78116/jalen-duren
**Key Facts [HIGH confidence — multiple sources]:**
- October 1 deadline (3 days away) for Duren to accept or decline qualifying offer
- QO value: $9.6M
- Pistons' extension offer: five years, $200M
- Weight clause in the $200M offer is the reported sticking point
- Rose Rule eligibility: Duren qualifies at 30% of cap, approximately five years, $287M
- Gap between offer and eligibility: approximately $87M
- Pistons can push QO deadline to March 1, 2027 if deal appears close
- Accepting QO strips Detroit of matching rights; Duren becomes unrestricted FA in 2027
- Duren stats last season: first All-Star, third-team All-NBA; 19.5 pts, 10.5 reb per game (HIGH — from multiple sources Sept. 22-27)
- Duren age: 22
**Freshness:** Multiple sources Sept. 22-28. Deadline countdown is time-sensitive. HIGH freshness.
**Why it matters:** Most consequential contract standoff heading into training camp.
